# WORK_UNIT_CASE: 750/17 provenance fixture. Exact captured output of
# `cargo deny check --help` from the pinned scanner (cargo-deny 0.20.2).
# `check` accepts no --locked flag: dependency locking for deny flows from
# Cargo.lock + deny.toml (read-only reference), never an invented flag.
#
# Checks a project's crate graph
#
# Usage: cargo-deny.exe check [OPTIONS] [WHICH]...
#
# Arguments:
#   [WHICH]...
#           The check(s) to perform.
#
#           [possible values: advisories, bans, licenses, sources, all]
#
# Options:
#   -g, --graph <GRAPH>
#           Path to graph output root directory.
#
#           If set, a dotviz graph will be created for whenever multiple versions of the same crate are detected.
#
#           Each file will be created at `<dir>/graph_output/<crate_name>.dot`. `<dir>/graph_output/*` is deleted and recreated each run.
#
#       --hide-inclusion-graph
#           Hide the inclusion graph when printing out info for a crate.
#
#   -s, --show-stats
#           Show stats for all the checks, regardless of the log-level.
#
#   -W, --warn <WARN>
#           Set lint warnings.
#
#   -A, --allow <ALLOW>
#           Set lint allowed.
#
#   -D, --deny <DENY>
#           Set lint denied.
#
#   -h, --help
#           Print help (see a summary with '-h')
